稻香控股: transaction_complexity = High. Document-level review increasingly supports the view that 00573 is a heavy, integrated operating system rather than a clean platform shell. Beyond family trust control and family-embedded management, the Dongguan production / logistics node now looks like a recurring structural entanglement: annual reports repeatedly identify the Dongguan food processing and logistics centre as a named operating hub; a Master Tenancy Agreement with connected landlord Dongguan Tian Yao was disclosed in 2022 for 6 June 2022 to 5 June 2024, renewed again in 2024 for 6 June 2024 to 5 June 2026, and the FY2025 annual report still records related-party lease payment of HK$8.583m and management fee of HK$8.373m to the same landlord. The 2024 supplemental announcement also clarifies both fixed-rent / right-of-use-asset and turnover-rent continuing connected-transaction elements. This points to site-and-operations entanglement, not just broad family ownership.
